Step: 17 weeks + 6 days = 17×7 + 6 = 119 + 6 = 125 days.  
01-04-1402 (assuming DD-MM-YYYY) → 1402-04-01 in ISO.  
Add 125 days: April has 30 days in Jalali? Wait — the year 1402 is likely Jalali (Persian) calendar, not Gregorian.  
But the problem says "Use Gregorian calendar arithmetic." So treat 01-04-1402 as Gregorian date: 1402-04-01.  
1402 is not a leap year in Gregorian (leap year rule: divisible by 4, but 1402/4=350.5, no).  
April: 30 days, May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, August: 31, September: 30.  
From April 1:  
125 days: April 1 + 29 days → April 30 (29 days added → April 30), so 125 - 29 = 96 left.  
May 31 → 96 - 31 = 65 left.  
June 30 → 65 - 30 = 35 left.  
July 31 → 35 - 31 = 4 left.  
August 1 + 4 days = August 5, 1402.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1402-08-05
